description: Read one exact product with dated options, native prices, source evidence and original merchant purchase route. recordedBenefitRestrictions contains dated exact-product purchase exclusions, separate from affiliate commission rules; never remove buyer benefits or assume a discount. Includes dated recordedReturnPolicy declarations or explicit unknown; no buyer return eligibility, current fee/refund quote or inferred return deadline. Read complete product data and all published variants, native currency, capture time and source. recordedUseInstructions is a dated exact-product storage/preparation declaration or null. A valid storage record can have cooking:null when complete steps are not recorded; this never implies no cooking or ready-to-eat. It is not live package verification; component minutes are not total elapsed cooking time, and no temperature/lifetime or quantity scaling is inferred. recordedOptionIdentity reports bounded within-dated-product SKU ambiguity, not global/current uniqueness; keep exact variant ID and full option name even if SKU is unique. SKU alone never confirms size, merchant selection or quantity stock. null means unverified. On tool failure inspect isError and structuredContent.recovery for required fields and exact product-ID sources. KR/US recovery examples are diagnostic documentation only, never buyer defaults or automatic retries.
name: get_product
